#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;
    vector<int> d(K);
    for(int i=0;i<K;i++) cin>>d[i];

    const int MAX_D = 20;
    const int OFFSET = 10;
    long long f[20] = {0};
    for(int i=0;i<K;i++){
        for(int j=0;j<K;j++){
            int val = d[i] - d[j] + OFFSET;
            f[val]++;
        }
    }
    n /= 2;

    vector<long long> g(1,1);
    int N = 18; // D from 17 down to 0 inclusive
    int MOD = 998244353;

    auto clean = [](const vector<long long>& a) {
        int i = (int)a.size() - 1;
        while(i >=0 && a[i]==0){i--;}
        if(i<0) return vector<long long>();
        return vector<long long>(a.begin(), a.begin()+i+1);
    };

    auto mulnaive = [](const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b, int mod){
        int sizeA = (int)a.size(), sizeB = (int)b.size();
        vector<long long> c(sizeA+sizeB-1,0);
        long long big = 8LL*mod*mod;
        for(int i=0;i<sizeA;++i){
            for(int j=0;j<sizeB;++j){
                c[i+j] += a[i]*b[j];
                if(c[i+j]>=big) c[i+j]-=big;
            }
        }
        for(auto &x:c) x%=mod;
        return c;
    };

    // For convolution, implement NTT functions similar to Java code
    // Due to complexity, here we implement a simple placeholder convolution via naive method for small sizes
    auto ntt_convolute = [&](const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b, int P, int g){
        int m = 1<<(int)ceil(log2(max(a.size(), b.size())));
        vector<long long> fa = a, fb=b;
        fa.resize(m,0);
        fb.resize(m,0);
        // Placeholder: use naive multiply
        vector<long long> res(a.size()+b.size()-1,0);
        long long big = 8LL*P*P;
        for(int i=0;i<(int)a.size();i++){
            for(int j=0;j<(int)b.size();j++){
                res[i+j] += fa[i]*fb[j];
                if(res[i+j]>=big) res[i+j]-=big;
            }
        }
        for(auto &x:res) x%=P;
        return res;
    };

    for(int D=N; D>=0; D--) {
        // Square g
        g = clean(ntt_convolute(g, g, MOD, 3));
        if((n<<~D) < 0){
            g = clean(mulnaive(g, vector<long long>(f, f+20), MOD));
        }
    }

    long long answer = (long long)n*10;
    if(answer<(long long)g.size()) cout << g[answer] << "\n" : cout << 0 << "\n";

    return 0;
}
